answer_plus1_99nights:
Yes to both, measured against their peaks. Neither has disappeared, and both are still top-10 by raw player count. But both are shrinking, and a new game in either format would arrive late.

+1 RUNNERS: the pure "+1 Speed ___ Escape" runner has fallen off.
- +1 Speed Keyboard Escape, the format leader, has about 128K-267K players now. The trackers disagree on the exact figure. Its peak was 3.69M-7.26M (Jul 18), so it is down 93-98%.
- It is still losing players. It had 316K on Sep 5 and 128K-267K in late September, a drop of about 15-60% in three weeks depending on the tracker. The Sep 19 Admin Abuse drew about 5.2M RSVPs and did not stop the decline.
- +1 Speed Monkey Escape has about 49K against a 1.52M all-time high (-97%).
- Dozens of reskins (Spidey, Slime, Zombie, ASMR) crowd the category. The Sep 27 market scout puts "+1 Escape clones" on its avoid list.
- The exception is +1 mixed with a second game loop. +1 Loot To Forge (+1 plus dungeons and forging) has 46K-62K now, peaked at 80.4K around Sep 28, and is 7 weeks old. +1 Wings For Eggs has 12-14K and its visits roughly tripled in September.
- A +1 twist alone no longer brings players. +1 DMG FPS has only 1.6K-8.4K despite a 94.9% rating.

99 NIGHTS IN THE FOREST: it has fallen off from its peak and now only jumps on update days.
- Its normal player count is 104K-260K across four trackers. The all-time high was 14.15M on Oct 4 2025, so it is down more than 98%. Against about 339K in July 2026 it is down 23-69%.
- The 7-day average fell 11% week over week (rovitals).
- The Sep 26 update went 282K to 1.55M to 661K within about 3.5 hours, then back to 225-260K by Sep 27-30.
- Every clone (Arctic, Wild West, Forest Roleplay, Zombie Girl) peaked between Aug and Nov 2025 at 29.3K or less. None set a 2026 high.
- One sweep labels it "steady" because it has not collapsed further this month. That is a different framing of the same numbers, not a different finding.

WHAT IS TRENDING RIGHT NOW (late-September numbers):
- Ride A Pet roughly doubled, from about 83K mid-Sep to 152-195K on Sep 29-30. Weekly updates, #3-#8 on Roblox.
- Build the Pyramid! grew from about 4.3K to 26-28K and is at 96% of its all-time high.
- Slayers 2 launched Sep 18 and has 129-215K, with a 232K peak on Sep 27.
- Illegal Soccer set its all-time high of 81.5K within the last 7 days.
- +1 Loot To Forge peaked at 80K on Sep 28.
- In pets, a small wave of "X for Eggs" games (race, jump, wings or swing to grab eggs) is growing. Jump To Steal An Egg set a new all-time high of 79.9K in the last 7 days.
- Steal An Egg is still #1 at 1.15-2.03M and gained 847K players over 30 days. But one tracker has it down 42% week over week since its 14.3M record on Sep 19, and the format is crowded.

HOW RELIABLE THIS IS: I combined five sweeps, but only two gathered their own numbers (charts and pets). The codes sweep returned no data. The creators and devs sweeps both reused the same saved research files from Sep 27-30, so I count them as one source. All numbers come from search-result snippets and the trackers often disagree, so ranges are shown. The Hunt: Roblox 20 event (Sep 17-28) and admin-abuse weekends inflated mid-September peaks, so expect event-related drops this week.

rising_formats.format: Ride-your-pet exploration sims with weekly biome updates (radar egg hunt, carry eggs home, hatch, weather mutations, rebirth)
rising_formats.examples: Ride A Pet (the only big example; the licensed How To Train Your Dragon ride game is falling at 3.7K)
rising_formats.evidence: Supported by two sweeps plus hard numbers. Charts: about 83K mid-Sep, then 152.9K (+6.6% day over day) and 160.6K on Sep 30. Pets: visits rose from 170.6M to 210.1M (+40M in about 2 weeks), and it shipped Update 1 on Sep 19 and the Volcano update on Sep 26. Creators/devs: 195K on the Sep 30 snapshot. Rank is disputed (#3 on zing, #6 on livecounts, #8 on the snapshot). The peak is also disputed: 804K (rovitals since Sep 13) vs 1.40-1.42M (rolimons). Current players are only 11-14% of peak, so its big spikes come from updates. The baseline itself doubled.
rising_formats.pet_fit: A direct fit and the best pet opening. Give each mount a way to move (glide, swim, climb, dig) that opens new areas. Ship a new biome and egg every week, like the Sep 19 and Sep 26 cadence. Keep weather mutations as a layer, not the core. The field is thin: there is one big winner and no named clones with numbers.

rising_formats.format: Server-wide co-op build goal (the whole server hauls blocks to one monument, with gym stats)
rising_formats.examples: Build the Pyramid! (Janitors Studios, launched Sep 3)
rising_formats.evidence: Supported by three sweeps. It grew from about 4.3K CCU / 1.1M visits in an earlier snippet to 26-28.3K CCU / 13-13.15M visits in late Sep, about 6x. It is at 96% of its 29,591 all-time high after less than 4 weeks. Updates came Sep 22 and Sep 25, and on Sep 26 the server cap was cut from 100 to 50 because of lag.
rising_formats.pet_fit: A strong fit as a hybrid. Pets act as haulers, bigger or rarer pets carry more, and the whole server builds one Pet Palace or Ark. Server milestones trigger server-wide egg drops or a hatch-luck boost. The server-wide goal also works as a live-event hook.

rising_formats.examples: Slayers 2 (full launch Sep 18); veterans with update spikes such as Blox Fruits and Jujutsu Shenanigans are STEADY, not rising
rising_formats.evidence: Supported by three sweeps. It has 129K-215K now (#5 on livecounts, #11 on the snapshot), a 231,959 peak on Sep 27 (about 86% of its 268,484 launch all-time high), and 72.6M visits in 12 days. It is holding after launch rather than fading.
rising_formats.pet_fit: A weak direct fit. The growth comes from an existing fanbase and brand. A pet game could borrow the look: anime-style companion familiars with elemental skill styles and form evolutions. Don't pitch it as an anime RPG.

rising_formats.format: Chaotic or skill soccer and short-round PvP with one absurd rule-break
rising_formats.examples: Illegal Soccer (4v4 soccer with guns and jetpacks; Clubs update), That Freekick Challenge (TFC)
rising_formats.evidence: Backed by a hard number. Illegal Soccer's 81,522 all-time high equals its 7-day peak, so it is still climbing 4+ months after launch, with 75K on the Sep 30 snapshot (#16). TFC is #3 on rovitals trending (score 407.1, +25.4% in 24h), with 7K now against a 21K all-time high, and has a TikTok loop of players recreating famous free kicks. Counter-signals: Murderers VS Sheriffs Duels is at -11.5% week over week, and Jump To Steal Soccer Players (a steal-a reskin) collapsed.
rising_formats.pet_fit: A moderate fit. Pet soccer with pets as the players and each pet's ability as the rule-break (a dash pet, a pet that can grab the ball), with collectible pets as the meta layer. Frame it as a sport, not a fight: pure pet fighting is falling hard (Grow a Chicken Fighter -94%).

rising_formats.format: Movement-verb egg hybrids (race, jump, wings or swing to grab eggs, then hatch for idle income)
rising_formats.examples: Jump To Steal An Egg, Race for Eggs, +1 Wings For Eggs, Swing For Eggs; Shuffle an Egg (launched about Sep 30, no data)
rising_formats.evidence: The pets sweep has hard numbers, and creators/devs back it for Swing For Eggs. Jump To Steal An Egg's 79,949 all-time high falls inside its most recent 7-day window. Race for Eggs set a new all-time high of 19,682 in late Sep, 3 months after launch. +1 Wings For Eggs visits went from 5.5M to 15.8M within September (12-14K CCU). Swing For Eggs figures conflict: 12.2K and 38% of its 32K peak (rolimons) vs 20.4K (market scout, Sep 27). Risk: the leader Steal An Egg may be cooling, and theme-only reskins (Brainrot Egg 4.2K, Lucky Egg 6.7K) failed.
rising_formats.pet_fit: A direct fit, but only with a new way of moving. The pattern is that clones which change how you move beat clones that only change the theme. Pick an unused movement (glide, dig, surf, climb, grapple) and avoid treadmill auto-play feeds, which carry delisting risk (Steal An Egg was delisted Aug 25).

rising_formats.format: +1 hybrids with a second loop (RPG, forge, FPS or clicker combined with +1)
rising_formats.examples: +1 Loot To Forge, +1 Wings For Eggs, +1 Drain Water Per Click, +1 DMG FPS
rising_formats.evidence: Supported by two sweeps plus numbers. +1 Loot To Forge has 46.3K-62K now and an 80,380 48h peak around Sep 28, with codes up to 50000CCU, and it is 7 weeks old. +1 Drain Water Per Click gained 229.6% over 7 days to 16.6K, but that snapshot is undated and possibly early Sep. +1 DMG FPS is disputed: about 2.6K (Sep 16) vs 8.2K (Sep 28) vs 1.6K (Sep 27). +1 Dino Evolution is at 38% of its all-time high and marked 'falling fast'. Only the stronger second loops hold.
rising_formats.pet_fit: A moderate fit. Use +1 pet size, level or speed per second as the hook, with hatching or forging as the real loop. Pure +1 runners are over, so the +1 must be a layer, not the game.

rising_formats.format: Steal-a base-raid with egg hatching (the Steal An Egg loop itself)
rising_formats.evidence: The sweeps split. Rising month over month: +847,150 players over 30 days (rovitals) and +51.6% for Aug 31-Sep 6. Flat week over week: about 1.3M on Sep 9 and on Sep 28 (charts). Falling: -42% week over week and 'falling fast' (pets/rovitals). Live count is 1.15M-2.03M. Its 14.27M record came on Sep 19 during an event, and the 24h peak is about 16% of that record. It is the biggest game, but it is plateauing and has 8+ clones.
rising_formats.pet_fit: A direct fit but late. Don't straight-clone. Borrow only the egg-steal-hatch economy and pair it with a new way of moving (see the movement-verb egg hybrids above) or the ride-pet loop.

rising_formats.format: Co-op and asymmetric horror in the October run-up (a seasonal pattern)
rising_formats.evidence: DOORS is +88.6% over 30 days on average players (rovitals, 'rising fast'), but -7.7% week over week. In 2025 horror rose in October (Fish It went from 186K to 389K Sep to Oct), and the 2025 Halloween Spotlight ran Oct 23-Nov 3 with 31 games. 2026 Spotlight dates are not announced. This is an inference from the seasonal pattern, not a live trend. Survive-the-night and anomaly horror are falling.
rising_formats.pet_fit: Use it as a live event, not a genre switch. Add haunted eggs, spooky mutations, limited-time Halloween pets and a pumpkin or corn-maze biome in late October. Don't build a 99 Nights-style survival game.

rising_formats.format: Rescue-and-clean creature tycoons (rescue animals, clean them, build a base, earn cash)
rising_formats.examples: Surf And Rescue (sea pets; avoid sharks), Unfreeze an Animal
rising_formats.evidence: Mainly one sweep. Surf And Rescue is #2 on rovitals trending (score 507.2, +132.7% in 24h, Sep 2026), guide sites say it 'exploded in September', and it has a 98% like ratio. No CCU was found. Unfreeze an Animal was flagged by IDK Stats on Sep 6 with no numbers. The pets sweep finds rescue and care games small and steady with no breakout (Save Animals went from 25.5K to about 2.5K).
rising_formats.pet_fit: A high thematic fit: rescue, clean and rehome animals for cash, with a collection meta. Verify Surf And Rescue's live CCU before committing.

rising_formats.format: Dungeon-crawler revivals and small tower-defense updates
rising_formats.evidence: Only one sweep, and the data is stale or soft. Dungeon Quest Reborn grew 276.9% over 7 days, with visits going from 12.8M to 92.8M by Sep 7, but that is early-September data. Re://Adventures is 'Surging' at 10.3K (undated). The creators/devs files list tower defense broadly as cooling.
rising_formats.pet_fit: Pets as dungeon companions or tower units, with hatching feeding team power. Only a secondary option.

falling_formats.examples: +1 Speed Keyboard Escape (Candy & Chocolate), +1 Speed Monkey Escape, dozens of Spidey/Slime/Zombie/Verity/ASMR reskins
falling_formats.evidence: Keyboard Escape: 3.69M-7.26M peak (Jul 18), 316K (Sep 5), 128K-267K (late Sep), down 93-98% from peak and still falling. Monkey Escape: 49K vs a 1.52M all-time high (-97%). The market scout (Sep 27) calls it saturated and puts it on the avoid list. All four sweeps with data agree on the direction for newcomers.

falling_formats.format: Survive-the-night countdown (99 Nights) and its themed clones
falling_formats.examples: 99 Nights in the Forest; in the Arctic, in the Wild West, Forest Roleplay, with a Zombie Girl
falling_formats.evidence: Baseline 104K-260K vs a 14.15M all-time high (Oct 4 2025), down more than 98%. About 339K in July 2026. The 7-day average is -11% week over week. The Sep 26 update spike went 282K to 1.55M to 661K in about 3.5 hours, then back to 225-260K. Every clone peaked in Aug-Nov 2025 at 29.3K or less and none set a 2026 high. The idea council rejected near-clones.

falling_formats.format: 'Grow a X' and 'Grow a X 2' timer farming
falling_formats.examples: Grow a Garden, Grow a Garden 2, Grow An Egg, Raise Animals
falling_formats.evidence: Grow a Garden is at 19-32K: -11.4% week over week, -18.8% day over day, -6.7% over 30 days, and about 99.9% below its 22M all-time high. Grow a Garden 2 went from 976K (June) and 483K (Aug 13) to about 4.7K (-99%). Raise Animals went from 169K to a 242 7-day peak.

falling_formats.format: Anomaly/observation horror combined with a service job
falling_formats.evidence: 1.27M peak on Jul 10, now 29K-59K, -57% month over month. The market scout's 206K to 52K. One outlier reading of 389K is undated. It has turned into an established game with a falling player count, not a riser.

falling_formats.format: Theme-swap Steal-a reskins and brainrot mashups
falling_formats.examples: Jump To Steal Soccer Players, Steal A Brainrot Egg, Steal A Lucky Egg, Escape Tsunami For Brainrots!, Steal The Brainrot Base, Plants vs Brainrots
falling_formats.evidence: Jump To Steal Soccer Players: 63.8K all-time high, then a 30.5K 7-day peak, then a 4.7K 24h peak (charts), vs about 30K on the creators snapshot, which conflicts. Steal A Brainrot Egg is 4.2K on 13.6M visits, Steal A Lucky Egg 6.7K, Escape Tsunami For Brainrots 5.3K, Steal The Brainrot Base 3.6K. Steal a Brainrot itself only moves on events (24M on the Sep 13 event, about 139-366K baseline).

falling_formats.format: One-shot novelty and social sims fading after the launch spike
falling_formats.examples: Search For The Needle, Build and Kill Zombies, Karinderya!, Mukbang Game, Sell Lemons
falling_formats.evidence: The sweeps disagree, and the newest dated readings point down. Search For The Needle: 86K all-time high, 22-27K (Sep 23-28), 11.1K (Sep 30), about 14 clones in 48h. Build and Kill Zombies: 140K all-time high, now about 15-23K. Karinderya: 295K all-time high and a 243K 7-day spike, then 17-42K (creators/devs call it rising at 29K on one data point). Mukbang: 107.8K (Jun 28), now about a 49.9K 7-day peak. Sell Lemons: 221K (June), 43.9K high in August.
130.5K (Aug 29) to 34.8K, -11.5% week over week, -19.2% day over day, and rovitals rates it 'falling fast' (-41.2).

falling_formats.examples: Steal An Egg's treadmill auto-play feed; Steal Fish Eggs' optional doomscroll
falling_formats.evidence: Roblox delisted Steal An Egg on Aug 25 2026 over its treadmill auto-play video feed and relisted it Aug 26. It also reportedly barred rewarding auto-play feeds from its Kids and Select catalogs. This comes from secondary sources and is unverified.

rising_pet_subformats: RIDE-YOUR-PET exploration with weekly biome drops. Ride A Pet went from about 83K (mid-Sep) to 152-195K (Sep 29-30), about 2x in two weeks, with +6.6% day over day and visits from 170.6M to 210.1M. Updates Sep 19 and Sep 26. Confidence HIGH (two sweeps plus a hard number). It is the only big pet format whose baseline is still climbing.

MOVEMENT-VERB 'X FOR EGGS' HYBRIDS (grab eggs by racing, jumping, flying or swinging, then hatch for idle income). Jump To Steal An Egg set its 79,949 all-time high in the last 7 days. Race for Eggs set a new all-time high of 19,682 in late Sep, 3 months after launch. +1 Wings For Eggs visits went from 5.5M to 15.8M in September (12-14K CCU). Swing For Eggs holds 12-20K (sources conflict). Confidence MEDIUM. Clones that change how you move beat clones that change only the theme.

EGG-STEAL BASE-RAID PLUS HATCH (the Steal An Egg loop). #1 on Roblox at 1.15-2.03M, +847K over 30 days, but flat to -42% week over week since the 14.27M record on Sep 19. Big but plateauing and crowded (8+ clones). Confidence MEDIUM. Ride it through a hybrid, not a clone.

PET TEAMS IN SERVER-WIDE CO-OP GOALS (inferred from Build the Pyramid!, which grew from 4.3K to 26-28K at 96% of its all-time high). No pet game does this yet, so it is an open slot, not a proven pet trend. Confidence MEDIUM for the format, unproven for pets.

RESCUE-AND-CLEAN CREATURE TYCOON. Surf And Rescue is #2 on rovitals trending (+132.7% in 24h, 'exploded in September', 98% likes), but no CCU was found. Unfreeze an Animal was flagged Sep 6 with no numbers. Confidence LOW.
MUTATION AND WEATHER LAYERS inside the winning games (Ride A Pet weather mutations, Steal An Egg mutations). They are rising as a system to add to a game, not as a standalone genre.
Watch list with no data yet: Shuffle an Egg (egg gacha mini-game, launched about Sep 30, from the xFrozen studio group), My Timber Pets (pets that work in an idle tycoon, 6.6K peak, flagged Aug 27).
falling_pet_subformats: PET FIGHTING / auto-battle: Grow a Chicken Fighter went from 242.7K (about 223K on Aug 22) to 13.8K (Sep 14), -94%. Battle Pet went from 22,112 (Jun 6) to 117. Battle Pets went from 3,682 to 129.
PURE PET RACING: Dog Race went from 17,569 (Jul 25) to 553 (-97%). Horse Race has 923 players on 181M visits. The only racing exception is the egg-grab hybrid Race for Eggs.
CATCH / TAME: Catch And Tame went from a 221.3K peak to about 16-18K (-92%). Battle Pets is at 129.

STANDALONE BREED / MUTATE / GROW-A-PET: Raise Animals went from 169,037 (Nov 7 2025) to a 242 7-day peak. Feed Your Pet! went from 23,055 to 1,596. Hatch A Pet went from 14,851 to 159. Grow An Egg is dead (141 peak).

PS99-STYLE HATCH-AND-EQUIP MULTIPLIERS for new entrants: Pets Universe (Sep 12) had 1,657 CCU in its first week and about 1M visits in 16 days. The established PS99 is STEADY at 48-78K, up from 64K in July, with no breakout.

PET ROLEPLAY newcomers: The Cat Shelter went from 29,998 to 1,331 (-96%) and Horse Life averages about 713. Adopt Me! is the exception, holding a STEADY 142-249K baseline with a 1.34M update spike on Aug 29.
ZOO / PET-COLLECTION TYCOON: Build a Zoo went from 95,191 (Oct 2025) to 1-2.6K despite Sep 21 updates.
LICENSED DRAGON RIDE/TAME: How To Train Your Dragon went from 33,164 (Jun 2025) to 3.7K (Sep 29 2026, #311). The ride format works (Ride A Pet), but this licensed game did not hold.

THEME-SWAP STEAL-AN-EGG RESKINS: Steal A Brainrot Egg is at 4.2K on 13.6M visits. Steal A Lucky Egg is at 6.7K; it launched 12 days before Steal An Egg and still missed the wave. Steal Fish Eggs peaked at 45.8K and its current count is unknown.

RAISE/CARE, DAYCARE and SHELTER: small and steady-to-falling with no breakout. Save Animals! went from 25,517 to about 2.5K. Animal Daycare (Anomaly) is at 7.5K of an 18.8K peak. Clean the Animal Daycare peaked at 8.9K and Rescue Pets! at 4.4K.
